'''Havao tabacc''' was a form of [[Tabac/Legends|tabac]] used as a commodity. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Bettle]] and [[Jaxa]] began marketing [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] to warring species located beyond the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and the pair brought back a full cargo of [[canta salt]] and havao tabacc from this venture.
